Name: Berechiah
Summary: Berechiah is named as the father of the prophet Zechariah (Zechariah 1:1, 1:7). Nothing else is told of him.
KeyStory: Berechiah's mentions are as Zechariah's father, in the opening verses of his son's prophecy.
LifeLesson: Berechiah, like Beeri and Pethuel, is remembered for a son God used. The quiet work of a household echoes in prophecy.
